chunk.why: the draw is batched, so rng_position is the end of the chunk while the accumulator holds only the consumed prefix of it; resuming from rng_position alone would skip the unconsumed tail and change the frozen stream

budget.call_cap_overshoot: none: a batch that does not fit is refused, so max_calls is never crossed
budget.wall_cap_is: a start rule: no batch begins at or after max_wall_s, so the run can finish one batch late -- at most 8,192 calls, but NO rigorous bound in seconds, because the 768 us/pair cost is a host-dependent average and not a per-call maximum
budget.nominal_overrun_is: a projection from the measured average; the recorded wall_overrun_s is the fact

why: progress record, not a result: the stopping rule has not fired, so no statistic here is a verdict
